title: Cost, Price, and Quality Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Label ten statements about generating a textbook as a cost, a price, or a quality, and see the reason for each.

learningObjectives: The learner will classify each of 10 statements about generating a textbook as describing a cost, a price, or a quality, with at least 9 of 10 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Statement 8 mentions both a cost and a margin. Explain why the statement as a whole describes a price.
commonMisconceptions: A number in dollars must be a price.
A service's charge tells you what delivering the service costs it.
A generated text that builds without errors is good.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 9 of 10 correct on the first attempt.
